defaults.description: Global default settings applied to all jails unless overridden.

name.description: Jail name (must match section header like [sshd]).

filter.description: Name of the filter (in /etc/fail2ban/filter.d/) used to parse logs.

logpath.description: Log file(s) to monitor, space- or comma-separated.

maxretry.description: Number of failures before banning (null = use global default).

findtime.description: Time window in seconds (or fail2ban time format like '10m') for counting failures (null = use global default).

ignorip.description: IPs or CIDR ranges to never ban (space- or comma-separated).

action.description: Custom actions to take on ban (e.g., 'iptables[name=SSH]', 'sendmail-whois[name=SSH, dest=root]'). Leave empty to use global default actions.

backend.description: Backend type for log monitoring (e.g., 'auto', 'systemd', 'gamin', 'polling') (null = use global default).

options.description: Additional key-value options to pass directly to the jail (e.g., {'port': 'ssh', 'protocol': 'tcp'}).
